architecture_breakdown.spatial_extractor: MobileNetV2 uses inverted residual blocks with linear bottlenecks, extracting lightweight 256-dim frame embeddings without heavy compute overhead.
architecture_breakdown.temporal_model: BiLSTM captures bidirectional temporal motion dynamics, analyzing both preparatory posture cues and immediate aftermath motions.
architecture_breakdown.attention_mechanism: Temporal attention generates dynamic weights across video sequence frames, focusing model capacity on decisive strike, crash, or weapon-raising moments.

evaluation_metrics.surveillance_implication: In physical violence surveillance, achieving 100% recall ensures ZERO missed fighting incidents. However, low specificity (20.43%) causes operator fatigue due to false alarms on rapid non-violent motions, highlighting the necessity of temporal smoothing and consecutive frame confirmation.

analysis.primary_confusion: NORMAL samples predicted as FIGHTING (74 instances, 79.57% false alarm rate)
analysis.root_cause: Intense non-violent gestures and rapid spatial movement triggered striking kinematics before threshold recalibration.

conditions.description: Standard CCTV illumination and clean temporal kinematics.
Severe underexposure, dim indoor or twilight surveillance conditions.
Direct sunlight blinding camera lens or powerful automotive high-beams.
conditions.transformation_params: Additive intensity shift: +0.25 offset + saturation ceiling

conditions.description: Fast subject movements or PTZ panning smearing skeletal joint trajectories.
conditions.transformation_params: Temporal 3-frame sliding average filter across sequence length

conditions.description: Thermal camera sensor noise, analog cable interference, high ISO grain.
Body parts obscured by foreground furniture, turnstiles, or pillars.
conditions.transformation_params: Random 25% coordinate dropout/zeroing across spatial features

conditions.description: Bandwidth throttling, 360p downscaling, heavy H.264 compression artifacts.
Crowded public transit foyer with intersecting pedestrian flow.
conditions.transformation_params: Cross-temporal interference jitter (10% random phase shift)
